'''Class-4 power converters''' were a model of [[Power converter/Legends|power converter]] manufactured by [[Tykannin Turbines]]. Modified Class-4s were used in the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[6X4 fusial thrust engine]] that were incorporated into ''[[Storm (Miy'til starfighter)|Storm]]'', [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Isolder]]'s personal [[Miy'til starfighter]].<ref name="EGVV" />
